children: EyePoint posted an updated investor presentation highlighting LUGANO Phase 3 DURAVYU topline results and a potential wet AMD NDA filing targeted for H1 2027.
LUGANO topline: DURAVYU showed strong anatomic control and reduced treatment burden but did not achieve NI in full dataset due to an asymmetric 9-patient cohort.
Excluding the asymmetric cohort, ad hoc analysis showed non-inferiority in BCVA (nominal p=0.0096), and median analysis also demonstrated NI versus aflibercept.
DURAVYU achieved superior reduction in treatment burden (≈42% fewer injections; nominal p<0.0001) and high supplement-free rates (54% at Week 56).
Safety: favorable repeat-dosing profile with low rates (<1%) of serious ocular AEs; some ocular AEs (e.g., conjunctival hemorrhage, floaters) were more frequent vs control.
Regulatory plan: EyePoint expects to pursue an NDA for wet AMD in H1 2027 pending positive LUCIA results and plans pre-NDA engagement with FDA in Q4 2026.
